first.text:
That was an internal label slipping into my message, sorry. It just means this would be the fourth version of your program since you moved over on 1 November: the original, two small amendments since, and now this one. Nothing more to it, and nothing you need to track.

In plain terms, what you'd be saying yes to:

- Monday gains incline dumbbell curls as its last exercise, after the rear delt flys: 3 sets of 8 to 12, working to an 8 out of 10 effort, 75 seconds rest, adding weight once every set reaches 12.
- Your current training block carries on as it is, no reset.
- Monday stays your shortest lifting day, about 53 minutes of its 75.
- Everything else in the week is unchanged.

The first week's starting weight will come from what you've lifted on incline curls before, and the curls appear in your Monday routine from the next week I plan for you, not this one.

Shall I go ahead and record it?
